extraction.notes: No sufficiently documented 2026 or 2027 summer camp offering was found on accessible official pages. The current Classes page lists fall 2026 drama and year-round dance instruction. Older official material mentions summer camps but does not identify current offerings or dates. Third-party camp listings were not used to establish a current program. The Junior Hub is password protected, and opening the Classes page returned no readable text; its indexed official text was accessible through search. The official Ludus calendar was found but did not provide readable summer camp details in search results. Summer apprenticeships are mentioned on Get Involved, but their eligibility, format and employment status could not be established, so they require further review rather than a camp card.
